# PlanWise ESL

> PlanWise ESL is an AI-powered lesson planning platform for ESL (English as a Second Language) teachers. It transforms hours of lesson preparation into minutes by generating complete, customized, CEFR-aligned lessons using artificial intelligence.

## About

PlanWise ESL was created by Dave Jackson, an experienced ESL teacher who understands the pain of spending 2-3 hours preparing a single lesson. The platform uses AI (leading models via OpenRouter) to generate comprehensive, pedagogically sound lessons in approximately 2-3 minutes.

The platform is live at https://planwiseesl.com

## Ideal Customer Profile

PlanWise ESL is built for:

- ESL/EFL teachers who spend too much time on lesson planning
- Language school administrators managing multiple teachers
- Private English tutors looking to scale their lesson quality
- Teachers preparing students for exams like IELTS
- Business English instructors needing specialized content
- Teachers at any experience level, from new to veteran

## Core Problem Solved

ESL teachers typically spend 2-3 hours preparing a single lesson. This leads to burnout, inconsistent lesson quality, and less time for actual teaching. PlanWise ESL reduces lesson prep time to approximately 3 minutes while maintaining or improving lesson quality.

## Key Features

- **AI Lesson Generation**: Generate complete, ready-to-teach ESL lessons in minutes, not hours. Lessons include warm-ups, vocabulary sections, reading passages, comprehension questions, discussion prompts, and more.
- **CEFR Level Support**: Full support for all CEFR levels from A1 (Beginner) to C2 (Proficiency), ensuring lessons match student ability.
- **Grammar Spotlight**: Visual grammar explanations with sentence diagrams and color-coded grammar components for clearer teaching.
- **Semantic Maps**: Visual vocabulary maps showing word relationships to deepen student understanding.
- **Student Vocabulary Tracking**: Tracks which words each student has learned to prevent duplicate vocabulary teaching and ensure progressive language building.
- **Lesson Categories**: Specialized content for General English, Business English, Academic English, Medical English, Legal English, Technology English, Tourism & Hospitality, Finance, Healthcare, Science, Arts & Culture, and Sports English.
- **Lesson Component Selection**: Teachers choose which components to include — warm-ups, vocabulary, reading, questions, discussion, grammar spotlight, semantic maps, and more.
- **AI-Generated Images**: Contextual, pedagogically aligned images generated for vocabulary and discussion sections.
- **PDF Export**: Download lessons as formatted PDFs for offline use or printing.
- **Vocabulary Downloads**: Export student vocabulary lists as HTML files.
- **Lesson Library**: Save and organize all generated lessons for reuse.
- **Student Management**: Track students, assign lessons, and monitor vocabulary progress.
- **Public Lesson Library**: Share lessons publicly for other teachers to discover and use.
- **Lesson Sharing**: Share individual lessons via public URLs.
- **Blog**: SEO-optimized blog with ESL teaching tips, strategies, and resources.

## Subscription & Pricing

- **Free Trial**: 2 free lesson generations to try the platform
- **Unlimited Plan**: Subscription-based access for unlimited lesson generation, powered by Stripe

## Technology

- Frontend: React with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
- Backend: Express.js with TypeScript on Node.js
- Database: PostgreSQL (Neon serverless)
- AI: Leading models via OpenRouter for lesson content; Replicate (FLUX Schnell) for image generation
- Payments: Stripe for subscriptions
